title: Insectoids
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The albino spiders, ash hoppers, chaurus, chaurus hunters, elytra nymphs, exploding spiders, frostbite spiders, nix-hounds and silt striders, with the Creation Club ones (the Web Mother, Arachnia, the nix-hounds, the elytra nymphs) beside their kin. The chaurus and chaurus hunters fight beside the Falmer, so their bands follow the Falmer rungs they share the hives with (*Falmer*).
